high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from the website "HT Auto," which is known for automotive news and reviews. The headline at the top reads "Drive Your Passion," indicating the brand's focus on automotive enthusiasts. The main content of the article discusses Ducati's upcoming teaser image of Multistrada's twin-beam headlamps with the tagline "Your everyday wonder." It mentions that the new bike will mark the commencement of the Ducati World Première 2022 web series. The article also hints that it will be a Multistrada model but does not specify which one.
